content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "You must finish the graduated licensing steps within five years [s18-c500-000]. With a G1 you wait 12 months before the G2 road test, or eight months if you pass an approved driver education course [s18-c500-000][s19-c500-001]. Your blood alcohol level must be zero [s18-c500-001]. You cannot drive between midnight and 5 a.m. [s18-c500-001]. You cannot drive on 400 series highways, and a passenger with at least four years of driving experience must sit beside you [s18-c500-001]."}
